correctness.rationale: In a complete multipartite graph a nonempty induced subgraph is connected iff it is a singleton or meets at least two parts, while a selected set dominates iff it meets at least two parts or equals an entire part. Their conjunction yields exactly the first support condition; applying connectivity to the complement yields c=1 or q(D)>=2. Inclusion-exclusion over disconnected selected sets, disconnected complements, their two-part intersection, and non-dominating singletons gives the polynomial. A fresh independent brute-force check of all 37 nondecreasing complete-multipartite profiles of orders 2 through 7 verified the literal definition, structural criterion, and every polynomial coefficient.
